_comment: Synthetic heat pumps (generator heat_pump, camber.datasets._synthetic_heat_pump; 0.105, #147), the air-source units -> CAMBER Role mapping. Every column is CAMBER's own: ZAT is the unit's own zone sensor and SAT its discharge air in F, FAN the supply fan (1 = running), OCC the occupied period (weekdays 07:00-18:00), HTG_SP / CLG_SP the active zone setpoints in F, COMP the compressor (1 = running) and RV the reversing valve (1 = heating, 0 = cooling or defrosting), OAT the outdoor temperature in F. The scenario column selects one unit per ingest run and is not a point; the water-source and loop columns are blank on these rows and are not mapped.
